comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber, versus extract and load an LP, place a stylus, and start playback.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires fine socket engagement, screw/collar manipulation, and response-guided iteration; record requires broad fragile-disc handling, spindle seating, stylus lowering, and button actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe bounded carriage cycles. Record requires correct seating and stylus placement plus five seconds of stable playback without handling violations.
comparison.reason: The record is a fragile-media loading and playback sequence, not a mechanism-calibration task. Any shared guarded-control actuation is incidental.
